query: What study designs, primary endpoints, and stopping rules best evaluate safety and utility of LLMs in prospective human-in-the-loop trials for diagnosis and treatment?

response.query: What study designs, primary endpoints, and stopping rules best evaluate safety and utility of LLMs in prospective human-in-the-loop trials for diagnosis and treatment?
response.answer: Randomized controlled trials with primary endpoints like diagnostic accuracy and treatment efficacy, along with predefined stopping rules based on safety data, best evaluate LLMs in human-in-the-loop trials.

results.title: Study with us - Griffith University
results.content: In addition to mechanistic studies, this project will evaluate the therapeutic potential of a newly developed Kir4.2 channel modifier in preclinical models.
